title: Chicken Tinola with an Indian Twist
description: A fusion of Filipino and Indian flavors, this dish is a hearty and aromatic chicken tinola with ginger, garlic, and a hint of spices. Serve with steaming rice for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: filipino tinola
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add sliced ginger and sauté until fragrant.
Add minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides.
Add Filipino tinola, garam masala, turmeric, salt, and black pepper. Stir well.
Add coconut milk and water. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
